task: Trip readiness review for Indonesia. Write a pre-departure checklist from the supplied records only: the entry requirement and documents to prepare, what to pack for each recorded season, and how to get around with each recorded transit option. One item per record. Where a record is missing or a rule must be confirmed, say to check Smartraveller or the official source.

evidence.title: Indonesia — entry requirement
evidence.text: Records supplied: 2 of 2 weather notes, 2 of 2 transit options. Visa requirement on record: visa-on-arrival. Entry notes: Visa on arrival is issued at major airports including Bali (DPS). Passport must have at least six months validity remaining.

evidence.title: Indonesia — weather: Wet (Nov-Mar)
evidence.text: Season: Wet (Nov-Mar). Daily afternoon downpours and high humidity in Bali. Island ferry services are frequently cancelled.

evidence.title: Indonesia — weather: Dry (Apr-Oct)
evidence.text: Season: Dry (Apr-Oct). Best diving visibility and reliable sunshine. Book accommodation early for the July to August peak.

evidence.title: Indonesia — transit: rideshare
evidence.text: Transit type: rideshare. Grab and Gojek are widely used in Jakarta and Bali, with designated rideshare pickup zones at the airports.

evidence.title: Indonesia — transit: ferry
evidence.text: Transit type: ferry. Fast boats link Bali to the Gili Islands and Nusa Penida, but sailings are cancelled in rough weather.

plan.objective: Plan a pre-departure checklist for Indonesia based on the provided evidence.

steps.description: Gather and verify the visa requirement and entry notes.
Determine the necessary documents to prepare for entry, including passport requirements.
Pack accordingly for each season: Wet (Nov-Mar) and Dry (Apr-Oct).
Research and plan the best transit options: rideshare and ferry.

success_criteria: The checklist includes the necessary documents to prepare for entry.
The checklist includes information on packing for each season.
The checklist includes information on the best transit options.
The checklist includes a note to check Smartraveller or the official source for any missing information.
